title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | The Grounds Developer Launch Update
summary: Hear directly from the The Grounds development team following the launch of EA SPORTS FC™ 27, covering early feedback and what we’re working on.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: It’s been great to see players jump into The Grounds, meet other players, and spend time across the different in-world activities. So far, we’re seeing plenty of activity around small-sided football, including 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and In-World Rush.

sections.title: What We’re Hearing From You
sections.summary: We’ve been monitoring your feedback closely, and there are a few topics that have come through particularly strongly. We’ve seen a lot of requests for a way for winners to stay on a pitch and build a streak.

sections.title: Other Quality-of-Life & Live Issues
sections.summary: We’re continuing to address issues as they are identified, investigated, and ready to release. Some current examples include: 5-star skill moves not working in small-sided matches: A fix has been deployed.
